name: cu-wire-data
description: Read-only licensed CU Wire Data research, including credit unions, HMDA, CUSOs, banks and regulatory data.

interface.longDescription: CU Wire Data gives Codex read-only access to licensed U.S. credit union industry data through a hosted MCP server. Use it to retrieve current industry aggregates, search federally insured credit unions, and look up institutions by NCUA charter number. Installing the plugin does not grant data access; users connect a licensed CU Wire Data account through browser-based OAuth approval.
defaultPrompt: Get the current credit union industry summary.
Find the largest North Carolina credit unions.
Look up Navy Federal by charter 5536.
